The issue was that when `from __future__ import annotations` is used, a return type annotation of `-> None` is converted to the string `"None"`. In `fastapi.dependencies.utils.get_typed_return_annotation`, this was being evaluated to `NoneType` (via `get_typed_annotation`), which then caused `fastapi.routing` to set the `response_model` to `NoneType`. This triggered validation instead of treating it as a bodiless response (which requires `response_model` to be `None`), preventing the correct use of `204 No Content`.

I modified `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` to ensure that `get_typed_return_annotation` returns `None` instead of `NoneType`. I added an explicit check for the string `"None"` and also a check to convert any evaluated `NoneType` back to `None`. This ensures that both `-> None` and `-> "None"` are correctly handled as bodiless responses when `from __future__ import annotations` is present.
